nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are the two specific forest stands studied in this research?
nodes.answer: The two forest stands studied are a Pinus pinea forest stand at Hoyo de Pinares and a Pinus nigra forest stand at Sierra de Cazorla.

For this purpose, we combine dendroecological tech- niques with detailed forest inventory data. Material and methods Study sites The study was performed using data from two representa- tive Spanish forest pine stands: a Pinus pinea forest stand at Hoyo de Pinares ( vila, 40 31 3,9 N, 4 23 52 W, at an elevation of 900 m) and a Pinus nigra forest stand at Sierra de Cazorla (Ja n, 37 48 49 N, 2 57 30 W, at an eleva- tion of 1,800 m).
